detail_contains: not a position this game begins from
why: The initial position is checked against the starts the game rules_id names accepts, not against one fixed board. This file names Xiangqi and opens from the Mini Xiangqi array, which is a real position of a real game — the wrong one — so nothing structural can catch it and the rules tier must. It is refused on the structural rung of that tier rather than by the setup predicate: a position of no board is one the predicate has no opinion about, which is why this file and start-fen-illegal-setup carry different statuses.
